title: Recipe 51 — Multi-channel Personal Assistant (one agent, four front doors)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp — one agent behind all of them, with per-thread sessions.”

beats.label: Blank the scratch file
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed showcase is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the channel tokens
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — four channels means four sets of platform credentials.

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “One agent block, one channels list. The agent has no idea which front door a message came through.”

beats.label: Lint it in place
beats.cue: “Clean — four channels and a router, and the schema still catches a typo in any of them.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated exactly at the channel credentials the spec declares.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

beats.label: List what it emitted
beats.cue: “A gateway, a session router, a daemon, and one agent. Four channels did not become four programs.”

verify.note: one bundle, regardless of channel count

beats.label: Read the file list
beats.cue: “That's the whole multi-channel story: fan-in at the gateway, one loop behind it.”

beats.label: Type the channels block
beats.cue: “Step 2: adding Telegram and Discord is two list entries, not two integrations.”

beats.label: Type the routing block
beats.cue: “Step 3: per-thread session keying — a Slack thread and a Telegram chat get their own durable histories.”

beats.label: Type the planner sub-agent
beats.cue: “Step 4: the planner is where multi-step requests go, so a slow plan never blocks the chat loop.”

beats.label: Type the permission rules
beats.cue: “Step 5: an assistant anyone in a Slack workspace can talk to needs rules more than a local coding agent does.”

beats.label: Read them
beats.cue: “The blast radius of a multi-channel assistant is everyone who can find the bot.”

beats.label: Find the session keying in the bundle
beats.cue: “Per-thread sessions as generated code — the router hashes the channel plus the thread id.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “One user in two channels is two sessions. One thread is one session, forever.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · run it, one channel at a time

beats.label: Boot with Slack only
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Step 1: start with the channel you already have tokens for. The others stay dark until you add theirs.”

verify.note: needs SLACK_BOT_TOKEN + SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET plus a model credential

beats.label: Mention it in Slack
beats.cue: [manual] “Typed in a real Slack workspace — that's the only inbound this shape has.”
beats.text: @multichat what's the weather in Tokyo right now?

verify.note: typed in Slack, not the keyboard

beats.label: Read the heartbeat block
beats.cue: “A long-lived daemon needs a liveness signal. Step 7's heartbeat is that, declared.”

groups.title: One more thing · the model choice

beats.label: Find the model line
beats.cue: “A chat assistant at four-channel volume is where a cheaper default actually pays for itself.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Same recipe as 49 and 50 — one line, and the reasoning for it is written down.”
